summary: For HA hub on SELinux, mount `/var/lib/pulp` and `/var/lib/pulp/pulpcore_static` from an external NFS export via `/etc/fstab` with `context="system_u:object_r:var_lib_t:s0"` and `httpd_sys_content_rw_t` respectively (`nfs defaults,_netdev,nosharecache`), run `systemctl daemon-reload`, mount, then run the installer and unmount `/var/lib/pulp/` afterwards.
questions: How do I set up HA automation hub with SELinux and NFS?
Automation hub NFS mount SELinux errors

answer_card.title: NFS mounts for HA hub on SELinux
answer_card.answer_md:
```
# /etc/fstab
srv_rhel8:/data /var/lib/pulp nfs defaults,_netdev,nosharecache,context="system_u:object_r:var_lib_t:s0" 0 0
srv_rhel8:/data/pulpcore_static /var/lib/pulp/pulpcore_static nfs defaults,_netdev,nosharecache,context="system_u:object_r:httpd_sys_content_rw_t:s0" 0 0
```
```bash
mkdir /var/lib/pulp/ && systemctl daemon-reload && mount /var/lib/pulp
mkdir /var/lib/pulp/pulpcore_static && mount -a
# run the installer, then unmount /var/lib/pulp/
```
Next: apply the SELinux context and configure `pulpcore.service`.
